high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a selfie outdoors during the daytime. The individual is smiling and appears to be in a good mood. They have short, dark hair and are wearing a black shirt with a pair of sunglasses hanging around their neck. The person also has small earrings in both ears. In the background, there is a parked car on the left side of the frame. The car's door is open, and part of its interior is visible. To the right, there is a motorcycle with a white helmet resting on it. A person is riding a scooter in the distance, partially obscured by the motorcycle.
